title: Exodus 28:3 — artisans filled with the spirit of wisdom
summary: Exodus 28:3: God tells Moses to speak to the gifted artisans whom He has filled with the spirit of wisdom so they can make Aaron's priestly garments; 'spirit' and 'wisdom' are highlighted in gold.

text.text: 3 So you shall speak to all who are gifted artisans, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments, to consecrate him, that he may minister to Me as priest.
